Change c0329. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. IX; 1831 Ch. XVII.

Context before (unchanged): "How is this?

1818 text: I thought I had moved your compassion, and yet you still refuse to bestow on me the only benefit that can soften my heart, and render me harmless.

1831 text: I must not be trifled with: and I demand an answer.

Diff: [-I thought I had moved your compassion, and yet you still refuse to bestow on me the only benefit that can soften my heart, and render me harmless.-] {+I must not be trifled with: and I demand an answer.+}

Context after (unchanged): If I have no ties and no affections, hatred and vice must be my portion; the love of another will destroy the cause of my crimes, and I shall become a thing, of whose existence every one will be ignorant.

result.rationale: The 1818 creature's plea for compassion, admitting his heart can be softened, is replaced by a threatening demand ('I must not be trifled with'). This changes how the creature presents himself, shifting from a pleading, redeemable being to a menacing one.
